text: Overview of COVID19-related consultations and groups, introduction of the Toronto Office of Recovery and Rebuild, and Section 21 process update.

The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board recommends that the Chief Recovery and Rebuild Officer, in consultation with the Film Commissioner and Director of Entertainment Industries,and other appropriate City staff, take into consideration the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board's concerns and suggestions on mitigating the impacts of COVID-19 in preparation for the recovery.
